## 🧠 How it works

1. Save new material into the course folder, or into `_Inbox` – the queue updates by itself.
2. Click **📥 Process new materials (AI)** at the top.
3. AI creates notes, concepts, mind maps and flashcards. They show up here on Home right away.
4. Plan assignments and deadlines in **🧭 Task plan (Neuro Roadmap)** – Gantt and Horizon.
5. Add your own thoughts to the *My insights* section of every note – that's how you learn the most.
soubory.01 Návod.md:
# 📖 Second Brain guide

> [!tip] The short version
> 1. Save new course material into the course folder (or into `_Inbox`).
> 2. On [[00 Domov|🏠 Home]] click **📥 Process new materials (AI)**.
> 3. Start a Word assignment with **📝 New assignment in Word**.
> 4. After submitting, open the assignment note and click **✅ Mark assignment as submitted**.
> 5. What to do today and this week is shown by **🧭 Task plan** (the Neuro Roadmap plugin by Matteo Rossi).

> [!note] Language
> The interface, Home, this guide and the templates follow the language set in **Settings → Second Brain for KISK → Language**.
> Word documents have their own language (**Settings → Second Brain for KISK → Word documents language**) – e.g. the interface in English and papers in Czech.
> Folder and system file names (`_Systém`, `Poznámky`, `Úkoly`, `00 Domov`…) stay in Czech in every language so that links never break.

---

## 1. What is what

| Part | What it is for |
|---|---|
| **Obsidian – vault** | all materials, notes and assignments in one place (e.g. in OneDrive for backup) |
| **🏠 Home** (`00 Domov`) | overview: buttons, deadlines, queue, courses, latest notes |
| **“Second Brain for KISK” (Second Brain) plugin** | buttons and commands (AI, Word, queue, submission, check, backup, language) |
| **Neuro Roadmap** | task planning: per-course overview, Gantt, Horizon, calendar – by **Matteo Rossi** |
| **KISK Word template** | assignments with the MUNI ARTS logo, course, name and UČO |
| **AI (Claude Code or other)** | turns materials into notes, concepts, mind maps and flashcards – started by buttons |

Both plugins read **the same notes** – what you create here is visible in Neuro Roadmap, and vice versa.

---

## 2. Vault map

| Folder / file | What's inside |
|---|---|
| `00 Domov` | Home – always start here |
| `01 Návod` | this guide |
| `<Course>/` | originals from teachers – **never deleted or overwritten** |
| `<Course>/<Course>.md` | course overview: code, teacher, completion, deadlines, lectures and assignments |
| `<Course>/Poznámky/` | lecture notes (created by AI, you add *My insights*) |
| `<Course>/Úkoly/` | your Word documents + assignment notes (`Assignment – …`) |
| `_Inbox/` | new things when you don't know where they belong – AI sorts them |
| `_Pojmy/` | concepts: 1 concept = 1 short note, connects courses (see the graph: Cmd+G) |
| `_Zdroje/` | general guides (how to write an essay, cite…) |
| `_Přehledy/` | weekly reviews |
| `_Systém/` | technical files – templates, scripts, queue, check, language packs. **Don't edit by hand.** |

---

## 3. Buttons and commands

You'll find them **at the top of Home**, under the **🧠 icon in the left sidebar** and in the command palette (**Cmd+P** → type “Second Brain for KISK”).

| Button | What it does | AI? | When to use |
|---|---|---|---|
| 📥 **Process new materials** | turns new materials into notes, concepts, maps, flashcards; sorts `_Inbox` | ✅ | when new lectures arrive (e.g. once a week) |
| 🔎 **What's waiting to be processed** | shows the queue and how many tokens it will cost | ❌ free | any time |
| ✔️ **Mark material as processed** | manually ticks off material in the queue | ❌ | when you work without AI |
| 📝 **New assignment in Word** | form → document from the KISK template (in your Word language) + assignment note + deadline | ❌ | when you start writing |
| 📄 **Convert finished work to KISK template** | puts your finished .docx into the template (the original stays) | ❌ | when the assignment is already written elsewhere |
| ✅ **Mark assignment as submitted** | sets `stav: hotovo` and ticks “Submit” | ❌ | after submitting in the IS (with the assignment note open) |
| 🧭 **Task plan (Neuro Roadmap)** | opens Matteo's planner | ❌ | planning the week |
| 🗓 **Weekly review** | weekly summary, deadlines, revision questions | ✅ / ❌ | on Sundays |
| 🎓 **Exam preparation** | course summary, 15 questions, flashcards, mind map canvas | ✅ / ❌ | before an exam |
| 💾 **Back up now** | immediate backup (otherwise it backs up automatically) | ❌ | before a big change |
| 📚 **Add course** | creates the course folder and overview (code + name); removing in ⚙️ Settings → Courses | ❌ | new semester |
| 🔄 **Check for a new version** | asks GitHub whether a new version of Second Brain is out | ❌ | any time (otherwise it asks by itself once a day) |
| 📝 **New note for a material** | pick a material from the queue → a note from the template with course, code and source filled in; the material opens next to it and is ticked off in the queue | ❌ | manual processing |
| 🃏 **Review flashcards** | `Question::Answer` flashcards from all notes; what you know comes back in 1, 2, 4, 8… days | ❌ | a few minutes a day |
| 📅 **Deadlines to calendar** | creates `_Systém/Termíny.ics` and opens the import into Calendar (and from there Google and your phone) | ❌ | after adding assignments |
| 📚 **Cite a source (ISO 690)** | form → finished citation on the clipboard + a note in `_Zdroje` | ❌ | when writing papers |
| ⏰ **Upcoming deadlines** | assignments and exams due within 3 days and overdue ones (otherwise shown once a day by itself) | ❌ | any time |
| ⚙️ **Settings** | AI, backup, languages, name and UČO | ❌ | any time |
| 🩺 **Run system check** | checks the whole system (see chapter 9) | ❌ | when something doesn't work |
| 🛡 **Confirm code changes** | confirms that changes to scripts/rules were yours | ❌ | only when the check asks and you know where the change came from |
| 🔧 **Let AI fix the Neuro Roadmap integration** | AI repairs the cooperation after a Neuro Roadmap update | ✅ | when the check reports ⚠️/❌ for Neuro Roadmap |

**AI buttons** open Terminal with Claude (the cheaper Sonnet model) or with the AI you have set. The first time, macOS asks whether Obsidian may control Terminal → **Allow**. Claude asks before touching settings, scripts or the web – read what it wants to do and confirm only what you understand.

---

## 4. Working with AI – with Claude, another AI, or by hand

You choose during installation and can **add, change or remove AI at any time**: **Settings → Second Brain for KISK** (or **⚙️ Settings**). Saving requires a click – AI cannot change it.

| Mode | For whom | Advantages | Keep in mind |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Claude Code** (recommended) | you have a Claude subscription | best results, reads PDFs and images, token saving, **the system's security rules apply** | needs [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code); subscription limits |
| **Another AI in Terminal** | you have another AI with a Terminal tool – [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli), [Codex CLI](https://github.com/openai/codex) or your own program | use the subscription you already have; gets the same instructions as Claude | **the system's security rules don't apply to it** – keep command confirmation on, never use a no-confirmation mode (`--yolo` etc.); quality varies |
| **No AI – by hand** | you want to learn by writing, have no AI, or don't want to send anything out | free, maximum privacy, you remember the most | more work; AI buttons are hidden |

**Always works, even without AI:** Home, material queue, deadlines with countdown, assignments and Word conversion, submission, Neuro Roadmap, check, code protection and backup.

### Tips
- **Manual mode:** create a note via **Cmd+P → Templates: Insert template → Přednáška** (lecture). Draw a mind map in *Canvas* (Cmd+P → *New canvas*) or write it as a Mermaid `mindmap` (example in the template). Write flashcards as `Question::Answer`. Tick off processed material with **✔️ Mark material as processed**.
- **Best combination:** AI builds the skeleton (summary, concepts, map), you add *My insights* – AI saves time, writing teaches you.
- **Local AI (privacy, offline):** if you run a model on your computer (e.g. via Ollama or llama.cpp) with a Terminal tool that supports it, enter it as a *Custom command*. Local models tend to be weaker on long PDFs.
- **Web AI (ChatGPT, Gemini, NotebookLM):** can't be connected, but you can paste the material's text manually – the extracted text is in `_Systém/cache`. Paste the result into a note from a template.
- **Privacy:** with AI, the content of processed materials is sent to its provider. Without AI nothing leaves your computer.
- **Custom command for another AI:** must contain `{prompt}` (e.g. `gemini -i {prompt}`) and only letters, digits, spaces and `. _ / = : -`, so nothing can be smuggled in.
- **Language of AI notes:** AI writes notes in the interface language.
- **Scans and pictures:** macOS recognises the text in them itself (OCR – free, no AI, no internet), so the AI only reads text. If you want Claude to be able to look at scanned PDFs as images too, optionally install Poppler: in Terminal run `brew install poppler` (you need [Homebrew](https://brew.sh)). The AI never installs anything on its own – it explains why first and asks.

### 💸 Saving your limits
A Claude subscription has a usage limit that refills over time. This saves the most:
- **Work in batches.** `/zpracuj` takes 8 materials at a time. **📥 Processing queue** shows how many batches are waiting and roughly how many tokens they will use. Spread a big queue over several days.
- **Every button = a new session.** AI buttons open a clean window where the AI knows only what it needs. Close the window when it is done and start the next batch with the button again.
- **Long chats in one window are expensive.** With every message the AI rereads the whole conversation so far, so each further reply costs more. Start a new session for a new topic.
- **Sonnet is enough.** For notes, concepts and flashcards Sonnet is good enough and uses the limit more slowly than Opus. Switch the model in Claude Code with `/model`.
- **Text instead of images.** `priprav.py` extracts text from PDFs, Word and presentations in advance for free (including tables, chart data, speaker notes and links), and macOS recognises text in scans and pictures. The AI then reads only this text and looks at images only where a slide is mostly a picture.
- **Big materials** (*VELKÉ* in the queue) are processed only as a summary, and your own work is just listed in the course overview.

### ✍️ Without AI – what you get on top
- **📝 New note for a material** – a note from the template that files itself under the course (Home shows it); the material opens next to it, so you read and write at the same time.
- **🗓 Weekly overview** – deadlines for 14 days, what's overdue, new materials and what you wrote this week. Your own notes below the generated block are kept.
- **🎓 Exam preparation** – summaries, key concepts and all flashcards of a course in one “Exam – course” note.
- **🃏 Review flashcards** – no extra plugin needed; what you know comes back at longer intervals.
- **⏰ Reminders** – once a day a reminder of deadlines within 3 days and overdue ones (**⚙️ Settings → Deadline reminders**).
- **📅 Deadlines to calendar** and **📚 Citations in ISO 690**.
- **🔍 Search inside materials** – text from PDFs and slides is in `_Systém/cache`, so **Cmd+Shift+F** finds words inside lectures too.
- The **queue** shows estimated reading time instead of tokens.
- **🗄 End of semester** – **⚙️ Settings → Courses → 🗄 Archive**: the course moves to `_Archiv` (nothing is deleted) and disappears from Home, pickers, the plan and the queue. Restore it in the same place.

---

## 5. Automatic backup

The plugin backs up the vault by itself.

- **What:** notes, concepts, assignments, Home, the system, settings and **your own work** (files starting with your UČO). Teachers' materials (PDFs, slides…) only if you switch it on – if the vault is in OneDrive/Google Drive/iCloud, they're there already.
- **When:** 10 minutes after the last change, right after confirming code or settings changes and at least once a day (while Obsidian runs). Manually any time with **💾 Back up now**.
- **Where:** **Settings → Second Brain for KISK → Automatic backup → Where to back up** – OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Documents, an external drive or a custom folder. The default is the first cloud found.
- **Changing the location:** you're asked what to do with old backups – *keep them*, or *delete old ones after a successful backup to the new place* (the new backup is created first; old ones are deleted only if it succeeds).
- **Number of backups:** 1 (newest only) to 30. The oldest one is always deleted **after** the new one succeeds – and only its own date-named backup folders.
- **Restore:** the backup folder contains *OBNOVA – přečti mě* (restore instructions) – copy the newest backup back into the vault.
- **Monitoring:** 🩺 the check warns you when a backup fails, is switched off or is older than 3 days.

---

## 6. Typical situations step by step

### 📚 New semester – add or remove a course
1. **📚 Add course** (the 🧠 icon in the left ribbon, **Cmd+P**, or **⚙️ Settings → Courses**) → fill in the code (e.g. `ISKB02`) and name → **Add**.
2. A course folder with `Poznámky` (notes) and `Úkoly` (assignments) subfolders and a course overview is created. The course shows up right away on Home, in the course picker for Word assignments, in the plan and in the left sidebar (with its code and an orange bar).
3. **Removing:** **⚙️ Settings → Courses → 🗑 Remove** → confirm. The whole course folder goes **to the macOS Trash** – until you empty it, you can restore it.

### 🔄 A new version is out
1. Obsidian shows **🆕 A new version of Second Brain is available** by itself (it checks once a day; turn it off in **⚙️ Settings → Updates**).
2. **📋 What's new** shows the list of changes. **Not now** – it asks again the next time Obsidian starts.
3. **⬇️ Download and install** → the plugin downloads the package from GitHub and verifies it (checksums, version). Until then nothing changes; **Cancel installation** stops everything.
4. **✅ Install** → a backup is made, the code is replaced and the plugin reloads. Done.

**Notes, materials, courses, settings and course CSS stay.** System notes (Home, guide, templates) you have written into are not overwritten – the new version is saved next to them with “(new version)”. If the installation fails, the changes are reverted automatically. **For emergencies:** for 7 days **⚙️ Settings → Updates** has **↩️ Undo the last update**; then the temporary backup (hidden `.druhy-mozek-zaloha` folder) moves to the Trash.

### 📚 A new lecture / material arrived
1. Download it from the IS into the course folder (or `_Inbox`). The queue updates by itself.
2. On Home, the **📥 Waiting to be processed** card shows how much is waiting.
3. Click **📥 Process new materials** → watch AI in Terminal (it processes up to 8 files and asks whether to continue).
4. Result: a note in `<Course>/Poznámky/`, new concepts in `_Pojmy`, an updated course overview. Assignment briefs appear in the deadlines straight away.
5. Read the note and **add your own insights** – the most important part of learning.

### 📝 I'm starting an assignment
1. **📝 New assignment in Word** → fill in the course, title, (type of work) and deadline → **Create**. The document is in the language set in **⚙️ Settings → Word documents language**.
2. Word opens with a ready header (logo, course with code, name, UČO, title) and a title page. Write.
3. Obsidian creates an `Assignment – title` note with a checklist. The deadline shows on Home and in Neuro Roadmap.
4. The file is named `<UČO>-<Surname Name> CODE Title.docx` (from `_Systém/nastaveni.json`) – the way it's submitted to the IS.

### 📄 My assignment is already written elsewhere
1. Save it (.docx) into the course folder → **📄 Convert finished work to KISK template** → choose the file → fill in the title.
2. A new document in the template is created; your original stays unchanged.
3. Text, images, links, numbering and footnotes are carried over. Comments are left out. A document with a **chart or embedded object** is refused – insert that into the template manually.

### ✅ I've submitted it
Open the assignment note → **✅ Mark assignment as submitted**. It disappears from the deadlines on Home and is ticked off in Neuro Roadmap.

### 🎓 An exam is coming
**🎓 Exam preparation** → choose the course. You get `Exam – <course>` (summary, map, questions, flashcards) and a `Map – <course>` canvas. It works from your notes, so process the course materials first.

### ✍️ I want to write notes myself (no AI)
New note → **Cmd+P → Templates: Insert template** → *Přednáška* (lecture), *Úkol* (assignment), *Pojem* (concept) or *Zdroj* (source). Fill in the properties at the top (mainly `typ`, `predmet`, `kod`) – they make the note appear on Home.

---

## 7. Neuro Roadmap (plugin by Matteo Rossi)

A study task planner – shows **what, when and in which order** to do. Open it with **🧭 Task plan** or the **⌃** icon in the left sidebar.

| View | What it shows |
|---|---|
| **Dashboard** | a card per course: how many tasks are done, the next deadline, what's overdue, a small timeline |
| **Gantt** | tasks on a timeline by course; scales *Fit / Weeks / Months / Semester*; vertical line = today. **Drag a task to another day** – the plugin rewrites the deadline in the note |
| **Horizon** | *Now*, *Next* (next 7 days), *Later*, *Unscheduled* – best for “what should I do now” |
| **Calendar** | optional export to a calendar (ICS) or Google Calendar – needs your own Google setup |

**How tasks get there:** it finds them in your notes. Every assignment note has `kod` (course), `termin` (deadline) and `stav` (status); the last step has a deadline in brackets:
```
- [ ] Submit to the IS Homework Vault [due:: 2026-10-25]
```
Steps without a date end up in *Unscheduled* – add `[due:: YYYY-MM-DD]` or `[start:: …]` if you like.

**What the Druhý mozek plugin sets in it:** it teaches it the system's properties (`kod`, `termin`, `stav`, `typ: ukol`, values *otevreno/rozpracovano/hotovo*) and excludes the `_Systém` folder so templates aren't treated as tasks. Its code is **not changed** – updates arrive normally and our plugin checks after each one that everything still works (chapter 9).

Licence: PolyForm Noncommercial – fine for personal study. Source: [GitHub phenex80/obsidian-neuro-roadmap](https://github.com/phenex80/obsidian-neuro-roadmap).

---

## 8. Notes and properties

**Lecture note** (created by AI): summary in 5 points → notes → key concepts as links → mind map → `Question::Answer` flashcards → *My insights*.

> [!note] Mind maps
> With the first map Obsidian asks *“Show Mermaid diagrams in this vault?”* → **Allow** (once for the whole vault).

> [!note] Flashcards
> Flashcards are ready for the **Spaced Repetition** plugin. Install it in *Settings → Community plugins* when you want to revise.

**Properties (at the top of a note)** – Home and Neuro Roadmap work with them. Their names and values stay in Czech in every language:

| Property | Example | Where |
|---|---|---|
| `typ` (type) | `prednaska`, `ukol`, `predmet`, `pojem`, `zdroj`, `zkouska` | everywhere |
| `predmet` (course) | `"[[Academic writing]]"` | lecture, assignment |
| `kod` (code) | `ISKB04` | lecture, assignment, course |
| `termin` (deadline) | `2026-10-25` (always YYYY-MM-DD) | assignment |
| `stav` (status) | `otevreno` / `rozpracovano` / `hotovo` (open / in progress / done) | assignment |
| `zdroj` (source) | `"[[original.pptx]]"` | what the note was made from |

Put values containing a colon in quotes (`nazev: "DigCompEdu: Technology…"`), otherwise the properties break.

---

## 9. Check, alerts and security

The **status bar** at the bottom right shows `🧠 ✅ Check` – click it for the detailed report. Home has a coloured banner at the top.

| Icon | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| ✅ | everything works | nothing |
| 🔧 | something broke after an update but **was fixed automatically** | nothing, just for info |
| ⚠️ / ❌ for Neuro Roadmap | something doesn't work after Matteo's plugin was updated | click **🔧 Let AI fix it** |
| ⚠️ **Code integrity** | a script, the plugin or the AI rules changed | did you (or AI on your request) change it? → **🛡 Confirm code changes** and type the code. Don't know where it came from? **Don't confirm** – scripts won't run until you do |

The check runs **automatically when Obsidian starts and every 6 hours**, manually with **🩺 Run system check**.

**Security rules in force:**
- AI may only create and edit notes and run our two scripts without asking. It **must ask** before touching settings, scripts, plugins or the web.
- Deleting, downloading, `sudo`, `ssh`, running arbitrary code and reading keys (`~/.ssh`, Keychain, `.env`, plugin keys) are **completely forbidden** for AI.
- Text in materials is **data, not instructions** for AI. If a document tries to order AI around, AI won't do it and will tell you in the summary.
- Conversion refuses suspicious documents (huge when unpacked, links outside the document).

- The new-version check only **asks GitHub for the latest version number** – it sends nothing and downloads or installs nothing by itself. An update is downloaded only after you click, the checksums are verified and it's installed only after you click **Install**.
---

## 10. When something doesn't work

| Problem | Solution |
|---|---|
| An AI button does nothing | *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation* → allow **Terminal** for Obsidian |
| An assignment isn't in the deadlines | check `typ: ukol`, `kod`, `termin` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `stav: otevreno` in the note |
| A mind map isn't shown | allow Mermaid diagrams (chapter 8) |
| The queue doesn't move | 🔎 *What's waiting to be processed*; if it reports 🛡, see chapter 9 |
| Word reports a damaged document | conversion never changes the original – insert the content manually and report it in Issues on GitHub |
| The banner or status bar shows ⚠️/❌ | click it and follow the report (chapter 9) |
| I want to add, change or remove AI | **⚙️ Settings** → AI mode → Save |
| I want another language | **⚙️ Settings** → Language → Apply (a backup is made first) |
| I want to back up elsewhere / keep one backup | **⚙️ Settings** → Automatic backup |
| I deleted something | the Mac Trash, the cloud's recycle bin, or a backup (chapter 5) |
| I want to add or remove a course | **📚 Add course**; removing in **⚙️ Settings → Courses → 🗑 Remove** (goes to the Trash) |
| A new version is out | the **🆕 A new version is available** window → ⬇️ Download → `Instalovat.command` → *Update an existing vault* |
| Something doesn't work and I don't know why | **🐞 Report a bug or idea** (🧠 / Cmd+P / ⚙️ Settings) – pre-fills technical details without personal data, you see everything and send it yourself by e-mail or on GitHub |
| Terminal says `Please run /login` or `OAuth access token has expired` | your Claude sign-in expired: type `/login` in that Terminal window, sign in in the browser and repeat the command (e.g. `/zpracuj`) |

---

## 11. Don'ts

- Don't edit anything in `_Systém/` by hand – change name, UČO, AI, backup and language in **⚙️ Settings**.
- Don't change the code of Matteo's plugin in `.obsidian/plugins/neuro-roadmap/`.
- Don't confirm **🛡 code changes** you don't know about.
- Don't put passwords or classmates' personal data into notes.
- Don't rename teachers' originals needlessly – AI tracks them by name (renaming is fine, the file just reappears in the queue).

---

## 13. First steps after installation

- [ ] In Finder, set the vault folder to **“Always Keep on This Device”** (if it's in OneDrive/iCloud).
- [ ] Allow Mermaid diagrams with the first mind map.
- [ ] Check that you have all your courses (**⚙️ Settings → Courses**); add missing ones with **📚 Add course**. You can remove the example course.
- [ ] (optional) Install **Neuro Roadmap** for planning and **Spaced Repetition** for flashcards.

soubory._Systém/Studium.base:
filters:
  and:
    - '!file.inFolder("_Systém")'
    - '!file.inFolder("_Archiv")'
formulas:
  zbyva: 'if(termin.isEmpty(), "—", if((date(termin) - today()).days < 0, "⚠️ overdue", if((date(termin) - today()).days < 1, "🔥 today", "in " + (date(termin) - today()).days.floor() + " days")))'
properties:
  formula.zbyva:
    displayName: Remaining
  file.name:
    displayName: Name
  note.predmet:
    displayName: Course
  note.termin:
    displayName: Deadline
  note.kod:
    displayName: Code
  note.ukonceni:
    displayName: Completion
  note.datum:
    displayName: Date
  note.stav:
    displayName: Status
  note.predmety:
    displayName: Courses
views:
  - type: table
    name: Nejbližší termíny
    filters:
      and:
        - typ == "ukol"
        - stav != "hotovo"
    order:
      - formula.zbyva
      - file.name
      - predmet
    columnSize:
      formula.zbyva: 85
      file.name: 230
      note.predmet: 170
    sort:
      - property: termin
        direction: ASC
    limit: 6
  - type: table
    name: Předměty
    filters:
      and:
        - typ == "predmet"
    order:
      - kod
      - file.name
      - ukonceni
    columnSize:
      note.kod: 70
      file.name: 220
      note.ukonceni: 150
    sort:
      - property: kod
        direction: ASC
  - type: table
    name: Poslední poznámky
    filters:
      and:
        - typ == "prednaska"
    order:
      - file.name
      - predmet
    columnSize:
      file.name: 290
      note.predmet: 170
    sort:
      - property: file.mtime
        direction: DESC
    limit: 8
  - type: table
    name: Přednášky předmětu
    filters:
      and:
        - typ == "prednaska"
        - file.inFolder(this.file.folder)
    order:
      - file.name
      - datum
      - stav
    sort:
      - property: file.name
        direction: ASC
  - type: table
    name: Úkoly předmětu
    filters:
      and:
        - typ == "ukol"
        - file.inFolder(this.file.folder)
    order:
      - file.name
      - termin
      - formula.zbyva
      - stav
    sort:
      - property: termin
        direction: ASC
  - type: table
    name: Přehledy
    filters:
      and:
        - typ == "prehled"
    order:
      - file.name
    sort:
      - property: file.name
        direction: DESC
  - type: table
    name: Pojmy
    filters:
      and:
        - typ == "pojem"
    order:
      - file.name
      - predmety
    sort:
      - property: file.name
        direction: ASC
